nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty Python package init file that marks the management commands directory as a package, enabling Django to discover custom management commands.

nodes.name: create_test_accounts.py
nodes.summary: Django management command that seeds one student and one committee test account with known credentials for development and manual testing.

nodes.name: Command
nodes.summary: BaseCommand subclass with a handle method that uses get_or_create to safely create a test student and a test committee user, printing their credentials to stdout on completion.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty Python package init file that marks the migrations directory as a package so Django's migration loader can discover and apply portal app migrations.

nodes.name: 0001_initial.py
nodes.summary: Initial Django migration that creates the core portal models: News, VolunteerLink, Competition, StudyNote, and ProblemReport, along with their base fields and foreign key relationships to the user model.

nodes.name: 0002_competition_deadline_competition_is_published_and_more.py
nodes.summary: Adds deadline and is_published fields to Competition, adds is_published to VolunteerLink and News, and alters field definitions across multiple portal models.

nodes.name: 0003_competition_drive_file_id_news_drive_file_id.py
nodes.summary: Adds a drive_file_id CharField to both the Competition and News models to store Google Drive file references alongside content.

nodes.name: 0004_replace_drive_with_local_imagefield.py
nodes.summary: Removes Google Drive file ID fields from Competition and News and replaces them with local ImageField columns, migrating image storage from Drive to server-local files.

nodes.name: 0005_add_point_models.py
nodes.summary: Introduces three new models for the points system: PointActivity (defining scoreable activities), PointSubmission (student proof submissions with status tracking), and UserPointProfile (aggregated student point totals).

nodes.name: 0006_competition_is_archived_news_is_archived_and_more.py
nodes.summary: Adds is_archived BooleanField to Competition, News, and VolunteerLink models so committee members can hide older content without deleting it.

nodes.name: tests.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive test suite for the portal app covering image upload workflows (News and Competition), the full points submission/approval/rejection lifecycle, and image content-type and size validation across 20 test cases in three test classes.

nodes.name: _make_uploaded_file
nodes.summary: Helper that builds an in-memory SimpleUploadedFile containing a 1x1 pixel Pillow image for use as a test fixture in upload-related tests.

nodes.name: ImageUploadTest
nodes.summary: TestCase covering committee image upload for News and Competition (create and edit), access-control rejection when a student attempts to create these items, and form rendering checks; uses separate committee and student test clients.

nodes.name: PointsTest
nodes.summary: TestCase exercising the full points lifecycle: page rendering, proof submission creating a pending submission, committee approval adding points to UserPointProfile, idempotent double-approval, rejection of already-approved submissions, and resubmission after rejection.

nodes.name: ImageValidationTest
nodes.summary: TestCase verifying that the portal rejects uploads with incorrect content types and oversized images for News and Competition, confirming no records are persisted on invalid input.

nodes.name: postcss.config.mjs
nodes.summary: PostCSS configuration exporting the active plugins (likely Tailwind CSS and Autoprefixer) used to transform CSS during the frontend build step.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: Project-wide stylesheet defining layout, typography, color variables, component styles for cards, buttons, navigation, and responsive breakpoints shared across all portal pages.

nodes.name: login.html
nodes.summary: Login page template extending base.html that renders the email/password form with CSRF protection and error display for the school portal authentication flow.

nodes.name: register.html
nodes.summary: Registration page template extending base.html with fields for email, password, and optional committee verification code; includes inline field error rendering.

nodes.name: base.html
nodes.summary: Shared base layout template that defines the HTML shell, navigation bar with role-aware menu items (committee vs. student), static CSS/JS includes, and template blocks that all portal pages extend.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Django template inheritance blocks (block content, block title) and the {% load static %} tag; navigation conditionally renders committee-only links via {% if user.is_committee %}.
